Chronology of every recorded fact about [[sealing magic]], in reading order. Generated from the same verified fact store as the main article.

== The Captain ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|'''Ch 3''' — Varic Vallenar's original specialty is sealing magic.}}

== The Engineer ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|'''Ch 8''' — Varic Vallenar is known for binding and sealing magic.}}

== The Knight ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|'''Ch 24''' — Binding and sealing magic is the specialty of the narrator.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|'''Ch 30''' — Sealing magic is easier to resist with aura and is slower than elementalism.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|'''Ch 39''' — Binding and sealing magic circles can appear on planets.}}

== The Pilot ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|'''Ch 12''' — The narrator uses binding and sealing magic to support Horizon's Absolute Burial.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|'''Ch 15''' — The Lichborn wizards created a counterspell for the narrator's binding and sealing magic.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|'''Ch 26''' — Sealing magic is Professor Vallenar's specialty.}}
